title: Azahar 2125.0-rc3: official release candidate
summary: Azahar published 2125.0-rc3 on March 20, 2026. The release record documents an official release candidate for the Nintendo 3DS emulator project.

blocks.text: The Azahar project published version 2125.0-rc3 on March 20, 2026. GitHub marks this entry as a pre-release; this distinction is preserved here so the build is not mistaken for a different update channel.
The official notes highlight the following changes: Fixed an issue which could sometimes cause the emulator to crash when changing the device orientation. @DavidRGriswold 1919.
